title: Code and data for: Regularity termination of the Reiner-Rivlin rotating-disk similarity reduction governed by the second normal-stress coefficient
description:
Python code, numerical data and figures for the manuscript Regularity termination of the Reiner-Rivlin rotating-disk similarity reduction governed by the second normal-stress coefficient.

The archive covers: the von Karman reduction with the pressure field that satisfies all three momentum components and its comparison with the zero-gradient closure; the closed-form critical shrinking rate lambda_c = 1/(2K) for K < 0, checked over eleven (K, S) cases; the Weissenberg-number collapse 2 Wi2 |lambda_c| = 1; the linear stability of both closures to similarity-preserving perturbations; and an assumed-disk torque example with a rheometry workflow on synthetic inputs.

Run python python/run_all.py to regenerate every table and figure. REFERENCE_VERIFICATION.md records how each citation was checked.
